summary: Tightened the prose, restored the dated 'as of August 2026' status framing for teaching, MINE and the EU expert roles, corrected the mischaracterized vera.ai/PROMPT project aims, and added the omitted European Parliament citation and Lumsanews coverage.

flags.claim: both of which completed their mandates to analyze digital narrative propagation and systemic platform risks
flags.issue: The fact sheet describes vera.ai as developing AI-based tools for countering disinformation and PROMPT as monitoring disinformation narratives in Europe; 'systemic platform risks' belongs to his separate JRC expert-group role, not to either project. Reworded to match the authoritative descriptions.

flags.claim: Beyond his university duties, Giglietto collaborates with European institutions
flags.issue: Present tense implies an ongoing collaboration. The authoritative biography states the JRC expert-group work in the past tense (reports delivered in 2026) and stamps only the EACEA appointment as current 'as of August 2026' (running to September 2026). Revised to past tense with the dated stamp preserved.

flags.claim: In the classroom, he instructs students in areas such as Generative AI and Media alongside Digital Social Network Analysis
flags.issue: The authoritative biography says his teaching 'has included' these courses; the present-tense 'instructs' asserts a currency the source does not stamp. Revised to 'his teaching has included'.

flags.claim: His recent research examining platform policies has been covered by national Italian outlets including Il Sole 24 Ore, Il Resto del Carlino, and Open.
flags.issue: The authoritative biography also states that the 2025 Meta working paper was cited in a written question to the European Commission (European Parliament, 2026) and lists Lumsanews among the covering outlets; both facts were dropped. Restored in the revision.

flags.claim: which serves as the active institutional umbrella for his research line following a succession of completed, externally funded sub-projects
flags.issue: MINE's active status is stamped 'as of August 2026' in the authoritative biography; the bio states it as a timeless present. Revised to carry the date stamp.

flags.claim: Giglietto has also contributed significantly to European research consortia
flags.issue: Filler intensifier ('significantly') and empty abstraction; similar padding appears throughout ('operates at the intersection', 'completed their mandates'). Tightened in the revision.
